rules.sentence: Luminal occlusion is also observed in chronic limb ischemia, without significant atherosclerosis, potentially due to the athero-thrombo-embolic phenomenon.[6]
The patient is usually above the age of 50 years; if younger, other differentials may be explored, such as Buerger disease and autoimmune conditions such as vasculitis.
